job_name.help: Input file name without extension, also used for intermediate files

mpsfile.help: MPS file to read from with external multipoles for embedding

guess.help: File to read the wave function if the use guess flag is set to true

moguess.help: Orb file to read ONLY the MOs from (geometry still comes from job_name.xyz, or from guess if that is also set) -- for warm-starting a geometry optimization step's own SCF from a PREVIOUS step's converged wavefunction at a different geometry, which guess itself cannot represent since it loads geometry and MOs together from the same file.

logging_file.help: File to send logging data to.
